description: This file defines the AsyncCommandClient interface in the org.eclipse.hono.client package, which provides methods for sending asynchronous commands to devices within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes method signatures for sending commands with or without additional properties, and references external classes such as Future, Buffer, and ServiceInvocationException.

classes.name: AsyncCommandClient
classes.description: An interface for sending asynchronous request-response commands to devices, scoped to a specific tenant and device.

methods.name: sendAsyncCommand
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous command to a device without expecting an immediate response, returning a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: sendAsyncCommand
methods.description: Overloaded method to send an asynchronous command with additional content type and properties, returning a Future indicating success or failure.
